role: Frozen dataclass event type constants for the Co-Being event bus, organized by subsystem.
detail: Defines 40+ frozen dataclass event types that extend cobeing.shared.event_bus.Event, grouped into subsystems: perception (ObservationIngested), teaching (node/edge create/update), expectations, rules, schema evolution, guardian responses, verification, gap lifecycle (identify/resolve/escalate), circuit breakers, camera (disconnect/reconnect), sessions, capability level changes, conversation turns and responses, cost thresholds, attractor monitoring, voice pipeline (input/transcription/synthesis/completion), interface degradation (voice/web available/unavailable), ESP32 drive engine (connected/disconnected/pressure updates), procedural knowledge (contradiction/computation/correction), and semantic knowledge (fact assertion/contradiction/scope count updates). Each event carries correlation_id for tracing across subsystem boundaries and session identifiers. Key constants and thresholds embedded in docstrings (e.g., confidence refresh formula 0.1 decay in ExpectationUpdatedEvent, categorical knowledge threshold default 3 for ScopeContextCountUpdatedEvent). No side effects; pure event definitions published by event subscribers downstream.
gotchas: TYPE_CHECKING import for VoiceTurnLog avoids circular dependency; VoiceTurnCompletedEvent uses dynamic __import__ as default_factory to instantiate VoiceTurnLog. File explicitly designates domain-level events that MUST NOT be imported or duplicated (SimilarityComputedEvent, VerificationCompleteEvent, guardian_events.* types) — live in their home packages. CorrelationId used throughout for tracing; several events have empty default string fields (node_id, label_raw, etc.) rather than required fields.
